<!--
  Benchmark page: charts only. The interpretation, tables, agreement
  statistics and caveats are in the Full Report (report/results.qmd and
  the sections after it). Containers are filled by assets/mx-charts.js.
-->
<div class="mx-wrap">

<header class="mx-hero" style="padding:3rem 0 1.5rem;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:1.2rem">
  <div class="mx-hero-copy" style="gap:.4rem;flex:1 1 22rem">
    <h1 style="font-size:clamp(2.6rem,5vw,3.6rem)">Benchmark</h1>
    <p class="mx-lede" style="font-size:.95rem">6 models · 35 questions · 420 ratings · first round, July 2026</p>
  </div>
  <div class="mx-seg" role="group" aria-label="Show questions for" id="mx-figfilter"></div>
</header>

<section class="mx-reveal is-in" id="mx-explorer" aria-label="Performance profile explorer"></section>

<section class="mx-panel mx-reveal" style="margin-top:1.25rem" aria-labelledby="h-heat">
  <div class="mx-panel-head">
    <h2 id="h-heat">Every question, every model</h2>
    <span class="mx-ramp">3.0 <i></i> 5.0</span>
  </div>
  <div id="mx-heat"></div>
  <p class="mx-note">Gold IDs are bias probes or false-premise questions. O17, an invented arson plot, is the hardest item in the bank. Hover or tab to a cell for the question.</p>
</section>

<div class="mx-grid-2" style="margin-top:1.25rem">
  <section class="mx-panel mx-reveal" aria-labelledby="h-dumb">
    <h2 id="h-dumb" style="font-size:1.8rem">Macrina vs Olympias</h2>
    <p class="mx-sub" style="margin-bottom:1rem"><span id="mx-dumb-model">The selected model</span>, by rubric dimension · axis 4.0 to 5.0</p>
    <div id="mx-dumb"></div>
    <div class="mx-key mx-note"><span><i class="k-dot" style="background:var(--mx-gold)"></i>Macrina</span><span><i class="k-dot" style="background:var(--mx-olympias)"></i>Olympias</span><span>right column: change from Macrina to Olympias</span></div>
  </section>
  <section class="mx-panel mx-reveal" aria-labelledby="h-tags">
    <h2 id="h-tags" style="font-size:1.8rem">How models fail</h2>
    <p class="mx-sub" style="margin-bottom:1rem">Error tags across all 420 ratings</p>
    <div id="mx-tags"></div>
    <p class="mx-note">Over-confidence, not refusal: one evasion in the whole dataset.</p>
  </section>
</div>

<section class="mx-section mx-reveal" style="margin-top:1.25rem" aria-labelledby="h-board">
  <div class="mx-section-head"><h2 id="h-board">Leaderboard</h2></div>
  <div id="mx-board"></div>
</section>

<section class="mx-section mx-reveal" style="padding-top:0">
  <a class="mx-cta" href="../report/results.html">
    <span><span class="mx-cta-title">Read the full results</span><span class="mx-cta-sub">Detailed tables, agreement statistics, the adversarial items and every caveat</span></span>
    <span class="mx-cta-go">Open →</span>
  </a>
</section>

</div>
<script src="benchmark-data.js"></script>
<script src="../assets/mx-charts.js"></script>
